qualification:
Actual native/complete borrowed-reference decoder-entry prefix on one heap.
The native call is verified to write only SDK borrow flags and decoder-hit
instrumentation before any reference reuse of its original owned byte buffers.
Native scan overapproximation and reached-decoder scope remain explicit.
domain: All proof58295/public1880/checkpoint1768 bytes in original owned allocations, all account metadata, every signed borrow flag, every nonzero usize Rc header, independent arbitrary data/lamport aliases and instruction/account lengths0..3. Native prefix frame forbids all byte/descriptor/metadata writes; only three borrow-counter cells and the decoder-hit array are permitted. After native SDK owners drop, the complete borrowed reference consumes those same original buffers without snapshots. Native decoder entry implies identical reference entry/error and scalar heap restoration.
remaining: Native exact std-any is a separately checked pure overapproximation; reference scan is false in the reached-decoder context and needs concrete source-scan transport. Common decoder returns InvalidAccountData cut; later success continuations, general runtime heap embedding and ordered child/state/log/oracle composition are not proved. Codegen/frame attributes alone are not a frame certificate; raw DFCC enforcement and every reachable property must pass.
